title: Late Breaking Results: Customized Diffusion Model Empowered by Heterogeneous Graph Network for Effective Floorplanning
problem: Classical analytical floorplanners are sensitive to initial solution quality; learning-based methods suffer high computational complexity and inefficiency.
motivation: Floorplanning quality directly impacts wirelength and area; better initial solutions significantly improve final results from analytical optimizers.
method: Proposes a customized diffusion model generating high-quality initial floorplans; integrates heterogeneous graph neural network (HGNN) to capture block-to-block and pin-to-block relationships; introduces guidance sampling function optimizing wirelength and overlap.
key_novelty: Diffusion model with HGNN feature extraction for initial floorplan generation, fed into analytical floorplanner.
contributions: Customized diffusion model for high-quality initial floorplan generation
Heterogeneous graph neural network explicitly modeling block and pin relationships
Guidance sampling function reducing sampling steps while optimizing wirelength/overlap
4.8% runtime reduction and 3.0% HPWL reduction compared to original floorplanner
limitations: Not discussed—focus on benchmark improvements without discussing scalability to very large designs.
primary_theme: Diffusion model with HGNN for initial floorplan generation
